a.lede: Some Linux maintainers are quitting under the crushing strain of AI bug reports, while others see signs for hope.
a.title: ‘We need more reviewers’: Finding Linux bugs is easy now – fixing them is another story

b.lede: Linus Torvalds thinks that AI fixes drove most of the progress in Linux kernel 7.4rc2 — BPF saw more AI-written fixes than bug reports, possibly indicating a tidal shift
b.title: Linus Torvalds says that AI fixes drove most of the progress in latest Linux kernel
